1-2.word_for_word: ततोऽष्ट-सप्ततितमे दन्तवक्त्र-विदूरथौ । — Then, in the eighth and seventy-eighth centuries, the two chariots with their teeth and mouths appeared.; हत्वा हरिः पुरे रेमे रामः सूतं ततोऽवधीत् ॥ — After killing the demon Hari enjoyed himself in the city, and then Rama killed the charioteer.; सखीनाम् अपचितिं कुर्वन्न् इत्य् उक्तं तद् एवाह---शिशुपालस्येति । — He said that he was making atonement for his girlfriends, and that he was the babysitter.; पारोक्ष्य-सौहृदं परोक्षे करणीयं सुहृत् कृत्यम् ॥१-२॥ — Indirect friendship is the act of a friend to be done indirectly.1-2
1-2.translation: Then, in the eighth and seventy-eighth centuries, the two chariots with their teeth and mouths appeared. After killing the demon Hari enjoyed himself in the city, and then Rama killed the charioteer. He said that he was making atonement for his girlfriends, and that he was the babysitter. Indirect friendship is the act of a friend to be done indirectly.1-2

4.word_for_word: मुकुन्दं प्राह दुर्मद इत्य्-आदेर् अधिक्षेप-परता स्फुटैव । — He said to Mukunda, “Durmada,” and so on, and it is clear that he is insulting.; परमार्थस् तु दुर्मदो गतमदः प्राह---मुकुन्दं तृतीये जन्मनि मुक्ति-दानार्थम् आगतम् । — Paramartha, however, who was very mad and who had lost his pride, said that Mukunda had come in his third birth to give him liberation.; अद्येति । — Today, it is.; जन्म-त्रयेऽन्विष्यमाणोऽद्य ब्रह्म-शापावसाने भवान् मम स्वमी दृष्टि-पथं गतः प्राप्त । — Today, at the end of the curse of the Brahman, whom I have been searching for in three births, you have come to the path of my own sight.; एतद् दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्या भद्रं भद्राम् । — This is, fortunately, fortunately, auspicious and auspicious.; अति-हर्षे वीप्सा । — Veepsa in over-joy.
4.translation: He said to Mukunda, “Durmada,” and so on, and it is clear that he is insulting. Paramartha, however, who was very mad and who had lost his pride, said that Mukunda had come in his third birth to give him liberation. Today, it is. Today, at the end of the curse of the Brahman, whom I have been searching for in three births, you have come to the path of my own sight. This is, fortunately, fortunately, auspicious and auspicious. Veepsa in over-joy.

5.word_for_word: किं च, हे कृष्ण, त्वम् अस्माकं मातुलेयो बन्धः । — What is more, O Kṛṣṇa, You are our maternal bond.; एवम् अपि मित्र-ध्रुक् मित्राणि घातितवान्, मां च जिघांससि तस्माद् अस्माकं त्वत्तो मृत्युः सनकाद्य्-अनुग्रह-प्राप्तो नूनं दुर्वारः । — Even so, you have killed your friends, and you are killing me, and it is certainly difficult for us to die from you, having received the grace of Sanaka and others.; अतस् त्वाम् एतावन् मात्रमहं याचे । — So that’s all I ask of you.; किं तद् आह---अमन्द सर्व-सहन-समर्थ । — What is that, he says, is slow and all-enduring?; क्षात्र-धर्मेण सेवितुं गदया त्वां हनिष्ये प्रहरिष्यामि ताम् एक-वारं सहस्वेति । — I’ll kill you with a club to serve you in the Kshatriya religion, I’ll beat you, and you’ll have to endure that once.; ननु वज्र-तुल्यां त्वद्-गदां को वा सहेत नैवम् इत्य् आह---अवज्र-कल्पया उत्पलम् आलावद् अति-कोमलयेत्य् अर्थः । — Indeed, who can withstand your club, which is like a thunderbolt?
5.translation: What is more, O Kṛṣṇa, You are our maternal bond. Even so, you have killed your friends, and you are killing me, and it is certainly difficult for us to die from you, having received the grace of Sanaka and others. So that’s all I ask of you. What is that, he says, is slow and all-enduring? I’ll kill you with a club to serve you in the Kshatriya religion, I’ll beat you, and you’ll have to endure that once. Indeed, who can withstand your club, which is like a thunderbolt?

6.word_for_word: नन्व् एवं हनने कस् तव पुरुषार्थस् तम् आह---तर्हीति । — Now, what is your purpose in killing in this way?; अज्ञ न विद्यते ज्ञो यस्मात्, हे सर्वज्ञेत्य् अर्थः । — Because there is no ignorant knower, O omniscient one, it means.; परमार्थतः स्वामिनम् एतद् देह-सम्बन्धेन बन्धु-रूपम् अरिं ब्रह्म-शापेन शत्रुत्वेन प्रतीतं त्वां हत्वा मित्राणाम् आनृण्यम् उपैष्यामि । — In the ultimate sense, I will kill you, my master, this enemy in the form of a friend in relation to my body, whom I have perceived as an enemy by the curse of the Brahman, and I will become free from the debt of my friends.; विशेषेणाधीयते मनसि चिन्त्यत इति व्याधिः । — It is a disease that is studied in a special way and thought about in the mind.; देहेऽन्तर्यामितया चरतीति तथा तम् ईश्वरं हत्वा क्षात्र-धर्मेणाराध्य । — They killed the Lord and worshiped Him in the Kshatriya religion, because He moved within the body.; हन्तेर् गत्य्-अर्थस्य ज्ञानार्थत्वाज् ज्ञात्वेति वा । — Or, since the meaning of the killer is the meaning of movement, it is the meaning of knowledge.; तेन यथा पित्र-दीनाम् आनृण्यम् उपयन्ति तद्वद् इति । — By doing so, it is as if they are indebted to their fathers and poor people.
6.translation: Now, what is your purpose in killing in this way? Because there is no ignorant knower, O omniscient one, it means. In the ultimate sense, I will kill you, my master, this enemy in the form of a friend in relation to my body, whom I have perceived as an enemy by the curse of the Brahman, and I will become free from the debt of my friends. It is a disease that is studied in a special way and thought about in the mind. They killed the Lord and worshiped Him in the Kshatriya religion, because He moved within the body. Or, since the meaning of the killer is the meaning of movement, it is the meaning of knowledge. By doing so, it is as if they are indebted to their fathers and poor people.

7.word_for_word: रूक्षैर् इत्य्-आदि प्रतीत्य् अभिप्रायेण । — roughly, etc., with the intention of perceiving.; तोत्रैर् अङ्कुशादिभिः । — with totras, goads, and so on.
7.translation: roughly, etc., with the intention of perceiving. with totras, goads, and so on.

16.word_for_word: एवं श्री-कृष्णो महा-बलान् अपि लीलया जयत्येवेति कृत्वा स कदाचिज् जरासन्धादिभिर् निर्जित इति पशु-दृष्टीनाम् ईयते । — Thus, Lord Kṛṣṇa, who conquers even the most powerful forces by His pastimes, is sometimes defeated by Jarasandha and others, according to animalistic views.; नित्य-जये हेतवः, योगेश्वरो भगवान् जगद्-ईश्वर इति । — The causes of eternal victory are the Lord of Yoga, the Lord of the universe.; विदूरथान्तम् आमथ्य पूतनादि दनोः कुलम् । — The dynasty of Dano, headed by Pūtanā, was defeated at the end of Vidūratha.; कृष्णस् तूपामन्नाराद् रामोऽहन् सूत-बल्वलौ ॥१६॥ — Krishna killed Suta and Balvala from Tupamanara
16.translation: Thus, Lord Kṛṣṇa, who conquers even the most powerful forces by His pastimes, is sometimes defeated by Jarasandha and others, according to animalistic views. The causes of eternal victory are the Lord of Yoga, the Lord of the universe. The dynasty of Dano, headed by Pūtanā, was defeated at the end of Vidūratha. Krishna killed Suta and Balvala from Tupamanara

17.word_for_word: तत् प्रसङ्गम् आह---श्रुत्वेति ॥१७॥ — That is the case, he argues, by hearing.
17.translation: That is the case, he argues, by hearing.

19-20.word_for_word: सुदर्शनं तीर्थम् । — Sudarshan is a holy place.; चक्रं चक्र-तीर्थम् । — The wheel is the wheel-shrine.; यमुनाम् अनु यानि तीर्थानि गङ्गाम् अनु च यानि तानि सर्वाणि गत्वा नैमिषम् अरण्यं जगाम् ॥१९-२०॥ — Having reached all the holy places along the Yamuna and along the Ganga he went to the forest of Naimisha (19-20).
19-20.translation: Sudarshan is a holy place. The wheel is the wheel-shrine. Having reached all the holy places along the Yamuna and along the Ganga he went to the forest of Naimisha (19-20).

21-22.word_for_word: अभिप्रेत्य श्री-राम इति ज्ञात्वा । — Knowing that he meant Sri-Rama.; महर्षेर् व्यासस्य । — of the great sage Vyasa.
21-22.translation: Knowing that he meant Sri-Rama. of the great sage Vyasa.

23-24.word_for_word: सूतं प्रतिलोम-जम् । — The thread is reverse-born.; न कृतं प्रह्वणम् अञ्जलिश् च येन तम् । — He who did not bow down and offer obeisances to him; अध्यासीनं च तान् । — And they’re sitting there.; तेभ्योऽप्य् उच्चैर् आसीनम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that he is sitting higher than them.
23-24.translation: The thread is reverse-born. He who did not bow down and offer obeisances to him And they’re sitting there. This means that he is sitting higher than them.

25.word_for_word: अजानन्न् अध्यास्त इति चेन् नैवम् इत्य् आह---ऋषेर् इति । — If he does not know that he is present, he argues that it is not so, because it is the sage.
25.translation: If he does not know that he is present, he argues that it is not so, because it is the sage.

26.word_for_word: ननु बहु-ज्ञः कथम् एवं कुर्यात् तत्राह---अदान्तस्येति । — If so, how can a multi-knowledgeable person do so?; गुणाय यथोचितानुष्ठानाय । — For virtue and for proper performance.
26.translation: If so, how can a multi-knowledgeable person do so? For virtue and for proper performance.

27.word_for_word: विप्रान् अध्यास्ताम् अन्यद् वा किञ्चित् करोतु किं तवेति चेत् तत्राह---एतद् अर्थ इति । — If he asks the brāhmaṇas to sit down or do something else for you, he replies, “This is the meaning.”; धर्म-ध्वजिन उत्तम-लिङ्ग-धारिणः । — They carried the flag of religion and the best of their limbs.
27.translation: If he asks the brāhmaṇas to sit down or do something else for you, he replies, “This is the meaning.” They carried the flag of religion and the best of their limbs.

28.word_for_word: भावित्वाद् इति । — Because of the future.; न हि भवितव्यं केनापि परिहर्तुं शक्यत इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that no one can avoid what is to happen.; अहनत अहन् । — Ahanat Ahan.
28.translation: Because of the future. This means that no one can avoid what is to happen. Ahanat Ahan.

29-30.word_for_word: ते त्वया । — They’re by you.; अधर्मिक-प्रतिलोम-ज-वधः कोऽयम् अधर्म इति चेत् तत्राहुः, अस्येति । — If it is asked what is the unrighteous killing of the unrighteous, they say, 'Asye.; पुराण-प्रवचनायात्मनः शरीरस्य नास्ति क्लमो यस्मिंस् तद् आयुश् च दत्तम् इति । — The Purāṇas preach that there is no fatigue in the body of the soul and that life is given to it.
29-30.translation: They’re by you. If it is asked what is the unrighteous killing of the unrighteous, they say, 'Asye. The Purāṇas preach that there is no fatigue in the body of the soul and that life is given to it.

31.word_for_word: ब्रह्म-वधेऽपि ममेश्वरस्येति चेत् सत्यम् एव, तथापि प्रायश्चित्तं कर्तव्यम् इत्य् आशयेनाहुः, योगेश्वरस्येति सार्धेन । — If it is true that even the killing of a brāhmaṇa belongs to my Lord, yet they say that atonement should be made with the intention that it belongs to the Lord of Yoga.; आम्नायो "ब्राह्मणो न हन्तव्य" इत्य्-आदि-लक्षणः । — The scriptures are characterized by the words "a Brahmin should not be killed.
31.translation: If it is true that even the killing of a brāhmaṇa belongs to my Lord, yet they say that atonement should be made with the intention that it belongs to the Lord of Yoga. The scriptures are characterized by the words "a Brahmin should not be killed.

32.word_for_word: तथाप्य् एतस्या ब्रह्म-हत्यायाः पावनं प्रायश्चित्तं हे लोक-पावन, अनन्य-चोदितः स्वयम् एव भवान् यदि करिष्यति तर्हि लोक-सङ्ग्रहो भविष्यति नान्यथेति । — Nevertheless, if you, O purifier of the worlds, yourself, uniquely inspired, perform the holy atonement for this killing of a brāhmaṇa, the worlds will be gathered together, and nothing else.
32.translation: Nevertheless, if you, O purifier of the worlds, yourself, uniquely inspired, perform the holy atonement for this killing of a brāhmaṇa, the worlds will be gathered together, and nothing else.

33-34.word_for_word: वधस्य निर्वेशं प्रायश्चित्तम् । — The atonement is the atonement for the murder.; प्रथमे कल्पे मुख्य-कल्पे । — In the first Kalpa, the main Kalpa.; विधीयताम् उपदिश्यताम् । — Prescribe and teach.; किं च, बत हे मुनयः, एतस्य दीर्घम् आयुः सत्त्वं बलम् इन्द्रियं तत् पाटवं च । — And what, O sages, is this long life, goodness, strength, senses and that path?; अन्यच् च यद् भवद्भिर् आशासितम् अपेक्षितं तद् ब्रूत सर्वम् । — And tell me everything else you hope and expect.
33-34.translation: The atonement is the atonement for the murder. In the first Kalpa, the main Kalpa. Prescribe and teach. And what, O sages, is this long life, goodness, strength, senses and that path? And tell me everything else you hope and expect.

35.word_for_word: अस्त्रादीनां यथा सत्यता भवेद् अस्माकं च वचः सत्यं यथा भवेत् तथा विधीयताम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the weapons and other things should be prescribed in such a way that they are true and our words are true.
35.translation: This means that the weapons and other things should be prescribed in such a way that they are true and our words are true.

36.word_for_word: तथा संपादयन्न् आह---आत्म वा इति । — Thus accomplishing, he argues that it is the self.; "अङ्गाद् अङ्गात् सम्भवसि हृदयाद् अधिजायसे । — "You are born from the limbs of the body, and you are born from the heart.; आत्मा वै पुत्र-नामासि स जीव शरदः शतम् ।" इत्य्-आदि-वेदानुशासनं वेद-वचनम् । — The soul is the name of the son, and he lives for a hundred years in the autumn. It is the discipline of the Vedas, such as the Vedas.; तस्माद् अस्य रोमहर्षणस्य पुत्र उग्रश्रवा भवतां पुराण-प्रवक्ता भवेत् स चायुर्-आदिमांश् च भवेत् । — Therefore, the son of this Romaharṣaṇa, Ugraśravā, will be your preacher of the Purāṇas, and he will be the first of all life.; अतः साक्षाद् अजीवनाद् अस्त्रस्य मृत्योश् च सत्याता पुत्र-रूपेण चायुरादि-सिद्धेर् युष्मद् वचनस्यापि सत्यता स्याद् इति भावः । — Therefore, since the truth of the weapon and death is directly from non-life, and the perfection of life and other things in the form of a son, your words will also be true.
36.translation: Thus accomplishing, he argues that it is the self. "You are born from the limbs of the body, and you are born from the heart. The soul is the name of the son, and he lives for a hundred years in the autumn. It is the discipline of the Vedas, such as the Vedas. Therefore, the son of this Romaharṣaṇa, Ugraśravā, will be your preacher of the Purāṇas, and he will be the first of all life. Therefore, since the truth of the weapon and death is directly from non-life, and the perfection of life and other things in the form of a son, your words will also be true.

37.word_for_word: प्रथमं तावद् अपेक्षितं कथयत तद् अहं करिष्यंईत्य् आह---किं वः काम इति । — First, tell me what is expected of you and I will do it.” He said, “What is your desire?”; किं विषयो वः कामो वर्तते तद् ब्रूतेति । — Tell me what the subject is that you desire.; अथानन्तरं ब्रह्म-दण्डं गृहीत्वापचितिं निष्कृतिम् अजानतो मे हे बुधाः, यथावच् चिन्त्यताम् अपचितिर् इति । — Then, O wise ones, I took the Brahma-scepter and did not know the expiation of the sins of the world.
37.translation: First, tell me what is expected of you and I will do it.” He said, “What is your desire?” Tell me what the subject is that you desire. Then, O wise ones, I took the Brahma-scepter and did not know the expiation of the sins of the world.

38.word_for_word: प्रथमं तावद् अपेक्षितं कर्तव्यं कथयन्ति, इल्वलस्येति द्वाभ्याम् । — First, they tell us what is required so far, and by two, Ilvalasya.
38.translation: First, they tell us what is required so far, and by two, Ilvalasya.

40.word_for_word: प्रायश्चित्तम् आहुः, ततश् चेति । — They call it atonement, and then so on.; परीत्य प्रदक्षिणी-कृत्य । — They turned around and circumambulated.; सु-समाधानादि-गुण-विशेषाद् एकाब्द-मात्रम् उक्तम् इत्य् अविरोधः । — There is no contradiction in the fact that only one year has been mentioned because of the special qualities of good satisfaction and others.; सु-समाहितः काम-क्रोधादि-रहितः । — He is well-concentrated and free from lust, anger and so on.; चरित्वा कृच्छ्राणि ॥४०॥ — walking in difficulties.; इति श्रीमद्-भागवते महा-पुराणे दशम-स्कन्धे उत्तरार्धे — This is the second half of the tenth Skanda of the Maha-Purana in the Srimad-Bhagavatam; श्रीधर-स्वामि-विरचितायां भावार्थ-दीपिकायाम् — In the Bhavartha-dipika, composed by Sridhar Swami; अष्टसप्ततितमो\ऽध्यायः ॥७८॥ — Chapter Seventy-eight.
40.translation: They call it atonement, and then so on. They turned around and circumambulated. There is no contradiction in the fact that only one year has been mentioned because of the special qualities of good satisfaction and others. He is well-concentrated and free from lust, anger and so on. walking in difficulties. This is the second half of the tenth Skanda of the Maha-Purana in the Srimad-Bhagavatam In the Bhavartha-dipika, composed by Sridhar Swami Chapter Seventy-eight.
